 Hon'Ble Praveen Kumar Giri, J. 
1. Heard Sri Amrit Shanker Dubey, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Anees Baig, learned
counsel for the opposite party no. 2.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that he has filed this Criminal Misc. Application under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023 with the relief which has been mentioned in the prayer clause of the application.
3.
The relief which has been mentioned in the application is delineated below:-

"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application under 528 of B.N.S.S. and quash the cognizance/summoning order dated 02.02.2024 and charge sheet dated well as 07.10.2023 entire as criminal proceeding of Case no.3080 of 2024 Versus Sabir Ali and another) arising out of (State the case crime no. 636 of 2023 under section 420,
406 IPC Police Station Dakshin District Firozabad pending court of Chief in the Judicial Magistrate, Firozabad in the terms of the compromise dated 12.03.2024 entered between the parties which is verified by the learned court below vide order dated 20.11.2024.
It is also prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to stay the entire criminal proceeding of Case no.3080 of 2024 (State Versus Sabir Ali and another)
arising out of the case crime no. 636 of 2023 under section 420, 406 IPC Police Station Dakshin District Firozabad pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Firozabad in the terms of the compromise dated 12.03.2024 entered between the parties which is verified by the learned court below vide order dated. 20.11.2024,
and/or pass such other and further order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the circumstances of the case.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 submit that both the parties have entered into compromise on 20.11.2024.

5. The learned counsel for the informant i.e. opposite party no. 2 submits that he does not want to proceed this criminal case against the applicants and they have also entered into the compromise and they have approached this Court by filing an application under section 482 Cr.P.C No. 31943 of 2024 and this Court has passed order dated 27.09.2024.

The order dated 27.09.2024 is delineated below:
"1. Heard Sri Amrit Shanker Dubey, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Gaurav Pratap Singh, learned State Law Officer for the State and perused the record.
Sabir Ali
And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23182110/

2 2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the cognizance/ summoning order dated 02.02.2024 and charge sheet dated 07.10.2023 including the entire criminal proceedings of Case No.3080 of 2024 arising out of the Case Crime No.636 of 2023, under Sections 420, 406 IPC, Police Station- Dakshin,
District Firozabad pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Firozabad.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that both the parties have settled their dispute amicably and entered into compromise dated 30.01.2024.
A copy of the same has been annexed as Annexure-6 to this application.
The compromise deed has also been filed before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Firozabad, however, the compromise entered into between the parties is yet to be verified.
It was requested that the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of aforesaid compromise.

4. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of with direction to the court concerned to verify the compromise deed dated 30.01.2024 after summoning the parties and after verification of the aforesaid compromise, the court below will provide certified copy of the verified compromise to the parties.
The aforesaid exercise of verification shall be completed within a period of three months.
5. For a period of three months or till verification of the compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
6. It is further provided that the parties are at liberty to file a fresh application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified copy of compromise.
7. With the aforesaid direction, the application is disposed of. "

6. This Court vide order dated 27.09.2024 directed to the concerned court to verify the compromise application dated 30.01.2024 and granted three months' time to complete the exercise of verification.

In compliance of order of this Court dated 27.09.2024, the trial court has verified the compromise and thereafter passed an order dated 20.11.2024 mentioning that the compromise has been made by the parties and they have been identified by their counsel.
The certified copy of order dated 20.11.2024 passed in compliance of order of this Court dated 27.09.2024 has been annexed as Annexure No. 2 to the paper book of this application.

Both the parties have settled their dispute out of the Court and they are residing amicably and peacefully and the informant has no grievance against the applicants, therefore, he does not want to proceed this criminal case against the applicants.

7. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, the trial proceeding of Case No. 3080 of 2024 (State Versus Sabir Ali and another) arising out of Case Crime No. 636 of 2023, under sections 420,
406 I.P.C., Police Station Dakshin, District Firozabad, is quashed.

The trial court is directed that no further criminal proceeding shall be initiated against the applicants in respect of case Crime No. 636 of 2023, pending in the trial court on the basis of compromise.
